GENERATE BURST KL-1-copy — Run C-9 P4, FIDELITY LADDER step 1: COPY (Matt: "can Astra not keep exactly to the image? ... Astra is generating images instead of copying them"). task_id "KL-1-copy".

THIS IS A COPY, NOT A NEW PAINTING. Use image_gen in EDIT mode on IMAGE 1 (a knight cut from a c. 1530 Flemish manuscript page). The goal is to keep the ORIGINAL PAINTER'S HAND: his exact line, his hatching, his uneven washes, the worn pigment, every small imperfection and asymmetry. For this step the REGISTER CARD above is satisfied BY THE SOURCE ITSELF: do NOT re-render, re-line, smooth, clean up, sharpen, restyle or 'improve' anything.

Make exactly TWO changes and nothing else:
1. BACKGROUND: replace everything that is not the knight and his poleaxe (the wooden fence, the ground, the tent, the sky) with flat uniform pure #00ff00. Where the fence crossed in front of his legs or body, continue his armour and tabard as the original painter would have painted them, matching the surrounding strokes exactly.
2. SKIRT: remove the pleated grey skirt below the blue tabard. The blue tabard ends at the hip; below it show his thighs in the same steel plate armour as his legs, painted in the same hand (IMAGE 2 shows a knight from the same manuscript dressed exactly this way; copy only that garment cut).
Everything else stays EXACTLY as in IMAGE 1: the pose (weapon raised), the helm, the blue tabard with its gold cross-crosslets and gold bands and its loose cloth folds and short open side flaps, the red lining, the poleaxe, the proportions, the colours, the scale of every brushstroke. Keep the canvas proportions of IMAGE 1 (do not crop the poleaxe or the feet; extend the green if needed).

Two image_gen EDIT calls: variants a and b, same instructions. ONE retry per variant only if the knight was redrawn or restyled rather than preserved, or the background is not flat green — name the reason. Copy outputs to out/KL-1-copy_a.png and out/KL-1-copy_b.png with sha256. No code. No other files. No web.
RETURN: receipt task_id "KL-1-copy"; images = the files with prompt, references (role + path) and elapsed_s; calls_used = the TRUE number of image_gen calls; status; concerns. Never PASS/FAIL.

references.role: IMAGE 1 — THE SOURCE TO EDIT (preserve the painter's hand exactly)
IMAGE 2 — garment cut only: tabard to the hip, plate thighs (same manuscript)
